plan: Sell all leveraged ETFs (SOXL, SPAL) to zero.

conservative.read: This plan prioritizes capital preservation, aiming for modest returns around 1.5% per month. It significantly reduces risk by cutting leveraged positions and holding a large cash buffer. Drawdowns should be minimal.
